description: Configure inventory safety stock levels for the clinic dispensary. Log in to LibreHealth EHR (admin/password). Navigate to the Inventory module (Procedures > Providers > Inventory or similar menu). Locate 'Ibuprofen 200mg' and set its Reorder Level to 150. Locate 'Metformin 500mg' and set its Reorder Level to 60. Ensure you save the changes for both medications.
